outcome: prolonged induction of labor (induction start to delivery time > 36 hours)
cohort: Nulliparous women with singleton term pregnancies, vertex presentation, and an unfavorable cervix (Bishop score <6 and cervical dilation <3 cm), who underwent induction of labor and had a vaginal delivery at a single academic center.
finding: An externally validated model efficiently predicted prolonged induction of labor (>36 hours) in nulliparous women with an unfavorable cervix, achieving an area under the curve (AUC) of 0.76 in the external validation cohort.
